history.summary: Maa Jagdamba Mandir is a white-marble Devi temple in P&T Colony, near MGM School, Sector 6, Bhilai (490006). Visitor accounts describe a self-manifested (swayambhu) idol of the Devi and a local legend that Mata Bamleshwari revealed her idol in a dream, giving the temple a distinctive local character; statues of Maa Bamleshwari, Maa Lakshmi and Maa Kali are worshipped. It is noted as a calm, peaceful shrine that draws large crowds during Navratri. Exact founding year UNVERIFIED.

town_description: Bhilai is a major industrial city in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, best known for the Bhilai Steel Plant of SAIL, one of India's largest steel works. It forms a twin city with Durg, about 30 km west of Raipur. Sector 6 is a central residential sector of the Bhilai township, close to the P&T Colony and MGM School.
